span.p: The expert finishes the section's interview and it is written (DomainExpert)

span.p: The expert accepts the offer of review [A grade of 70 or more, zero blocking defects, and a set that checks clean, unless the expert overrides the gate and the override is recorded in section 15] (DomainExpert)

span.p: The expert sets the section to final [An independent grading pass with zero blocking defects, and an approval recorded in section 15, unless the expert overrides the gate and the override is recorded in section 15] (DomainExpert)
